---
applyTo: "packages/app/**/*,packages/landing/**/*"
---

- Follow `packages/app/AGENTS.md`.
- For prompt send, session creation, workspace switching, and Veslo server client changes, read `docs/dev/opencode-workspace-runtime-architecture.md`.
- Keep UI work purpose-first, premium, and mobile-native.
- Prefer scoped async state over global blocking state.
- Use the app-specific verification commands from `docs/dev/testing-playbook.md`.
